question: What was warehouses open at year-end of Costco Wholesale Corp for fiscal year 2026 (for a balance: at the end of fiscal year 2026)? Give the one figure the filing prints for it.

facts.label: Costco operated 939, 914, and 890 warehouses worldwide at August 30, 2026, August 31, 2025, and September 1, 2024.
